name: HWR_EXPERIENCE_B
description: The experience table stores profile experience data.

columns.name: EXPERIENCE_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the experience table.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: The Id of the source for the profile which has the experience.

columns.name: COMPANY
columns.description: The company at which the person held the position.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The end date of the period for which the person held the position.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The start date of the period for which the person held the position.

columns.name: EXPERIENCE_TYPE
columns.description: The experience type of the experience.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
